messages:
Mika Chen: Hey team — unboxed my desk setup. Monitor arrived but no DisplayPort cable and the dock has an EU power brick (I'm in US). Also CorpNet wifi won't accept my cert after enrollment. Who should I ping for a replacement and quick wifi help? @Sam (IT)?
Sam (IT): sorry about that, @Mika Chen. Can you DM me the order #? We'll open a ticket and send a replacement DP cable + US power brick. In the meantime try hooking monitor to your laptop via USB-C alt-mode if available.
Mika Chen: Order #WF-49287. USB-C works but I only get 1080p and scaling feels off. macOS 14.2 also shows 802.1X error: 'No identity provided'.
Sasha - Onboarding: looping in @Sam (IT) and @IT Warehouse. tagging @Jamie (Manager) for visibility.
OnboardBot: Device shipment WF-49287 was delivered 2025-11-05 09:18 by FedEx. If items are missing, open an IT ticket here: https://redwood.internal/it/tickets
Sam (IT): Filing ticket now — IT-123456. @IT Warehouse please overnight a DP cable and US power brick. Also include a USB-C->DP adapter as a fallback.
IT Warehouse: confirmed. Shipping label created, tracking 1Z999AA10123456784. ETA 2025-11-06 by 10:00. We'll pack the USB-C->DP adapter and the correct brick.
Mika Chen: amazing, thank you. Any quick fixes for the 802.1X cert? I'm blocked from corp wifi so I had to use guest.
Sasha - Onboarding: try System Settings > Network > Advanced > 802.1X and see if a profile shows. If not, use Guest Wi-Fi and we'll escalate to IT. We can also do a 15-min screen share with @Sam (IT) if you want.
Sam (IT): also run in Terminal and paste output: `sudo profiles show | grep -i CorpNet` — if empty I'll DM you the mobileconfig. To install manually: `sudo profiles install -type configuration -path ~/Downloads/corpnet.mobileconfig`. I'll send the file in DM.
Mika Chen: will try after lunch and report back. Thanks for the fast turnaround :pray:
Jamie (Manager): welcome again, Mika — glad this is getting sorted. We keep spare DP cables in the team room if you need a temporary loaner. Ping me and I can drop one by.
Sam (IT): ticket IT-123456 updated with warehouse tracking. I'll follow up when it scans inbound. Please mark this thread solved once you have the cable and corp wifi working.
